title: Hillside Resort with Outdoor Pool and Lodges, 1950s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white landscape snapshot showing a tranquil hillside resort complex surrounded by lush pine trees and greenery. In the foreground, an outdoor swimming pool is framed by a decorative wooden pedestrian bridge and manicured hedges, while rustic cabins and larger Western-style estate buildings sit nestled against the rising wooded hill in the background.
